title: Alert — geopolitical / market catalyst
summary: A material macro catalyst has developed around the Strait of Hormuz. Donald Trump said the U.S. plans substantially stronger economic pressure on Iran as soon as next week. Reuters reports potential measures include expanded sanctions on Iranian oil channels, Chinese refiners/banks and other financial routes. Separately, Trump has said the U.S. may claim the Strait as U.S. territory, while Iran says it controls the waterway. Shipping remains severely disrupted.
why_it_matters: Hormuz handled roughly one-fifth of global oil supply before the war. Continued disruption raises energy/inflation risk, which can pressure Fed easing expectations, yields and risk assets—including crypto. Gasoline prices are already reported about 29% above year-ago levels.
crypto: I do not see evidence yet of a BTC threshold alert or capital-regime transition. The latest credible market indications still put BTC around the $63K area, well below the ~$65K level we’ve been watching. Friday’s decline was already associated partly with disappointment over U.S. crypto-regulatory progress.
business: No new TrueHold Wellness order, payment, fulfillment request, shipping issue, cancellation/refund, peptide message, or other actionable business email appeared in the connected inbox since the previous check. The only new messages were routine/news content.
watch_next: oil is now particularly important. A renewed crude spike accompanied by rising Treasury yields/DXY would worsen the Macro Liquidity score; meaningful Hormuz reopening or credible de-escalation would move it the other direction
